name: Reverse Nordic Curl
steps: Kneel upright on a padded surface with your knees hip-width apart, tops of your feet flat behind you, and arms crossed over your chest.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs tightly so your torso and thighs stay aligned in one straight line.
Lean smoothly backward from your knees under strict control as far as your quadriceps and knees allow without pain.
Contract your quadriceps powerfully to pull your straight body cleanly back to the tall kneeling start.
tips: Keep your hips extended in line with your knees instead of sitting back toward your heels.
Start with a partial range of motion and deepen gradually as your quadriceps and knee tendons adapt.
